model_output.verdict: A mid-market HR software seller with a promotion, a strong revenue year and a few details still missing.
write_up: You moved from SDR to mid-market account executive at Crestview HR Cloud, and your resume makes a solid case for another account executive role. A recruiter can see the revenue you closed, the companies you sell to and a referral program you built. The main question is how your sales performance compares beyond the one year shown.

The referral program is a great model for the rest: it names the partners and the deals they sourced without making a claim about deals closed. Your promotion is clear, and Experience is in the right place above Education.
